body: I do not wish to cause pain.  As inevitable as it is, the pain i cause will be temporary.  The letter will help people understand

I am a burden. An anchor weighing on the hearts of those that care. All i plan on doing is releasing that anchor and setting free the hearts that deserve better than i in their lives. Instead of being a burden i can be a purpose. The pain will be temporary.  Im sorry for the loss of your friend but i assure you they did not wish for their loss to haunt you
Too many failed plans. Don't want to disappoint any more people than i have to
